page: Vultr vcg-a40-96c-480g-192vram is a bare metal server belonging to the Dedicated Metal GPU family. It features 96 dedicated Intel x86_64 vCPUs and 480.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 5.0 GB per vCPU. The server is equipped with 1400 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. Although classified under the Dedicated Metal GPU family with NVIDIA listed as the GPU manufacturer, the active GPU count for this specific configuration is registered as zero.

This configuration provides a high density of dedicated CPU cores and system memory, making it suitable for resource-intensive workloads that do not require active GPU acceleration but benefit from bare-metal isolation. The inclusion of 1400 GB of NVMe SSD storage supports high-throughput local I/O operations. Appropriate workloads include large-scale database hosting, virtualization, heavy web serving, and general-purpose enterprise applications requiring dedicated Intel processing power and substantial memory capacity.
